construction.title: Construction
construction.description: Ground-up construction and full interior fit-outs for commercial, retail, hospitality and industrial spaces. Project management from design freeze through MEP coordination, snag close-out and signed handover. Civil, MEP, fit-out and finishing trades all run by Pro Care leads — no sub-contract chain between the slab and the keys.
scope: MEP design coordination and site supervision
Civil works: foundations, structural steel, blockwork
Finishing trades: ceilings, partitions, painting, joinery
Site safety, HSE compliance and toolbox talks
Signed handover with as-built drawings + warranty pack

trades.label: Trades on every project
items: Masons, steel fixers and shutter carpenters

post-construction-cleaning.title: Post-construction cleaning
post-construction-cleaning.description: Three-stage post-construction cleaning programme — rough, detail and final — engineered to deliver a snag-free building on the day the keys change hands. Concrete dust extraction, glass and frame polish, HVAC vent decontamination, floor stripping and sealing, and a full handover walkthrough. Discreet overnight schedules available for occupied retail and hospitality assets.
scope: Glass, mirror, frame and façade polish
High-rise and atrium cleaning with rope access
Bathroom and kitchen deep clean + sanitisation
Snag-list walkthrough with the main contractor

building-materials.title: Building materials
building-materials.tagline: Cement, blocks, plaster, tiles — sourced and delivered.
building-materials.description: Direct-from-source building materials retail with site delivery across Qatar. Trade pricing for repeat contractors, mixed-load tolerance for small projects, same-day dispatch on stocked SKUs and scheduled delivery for site-coordinated pours. Inventory covers cement, masonry, finishing and MEP-adjacent materials so a single PO covers the bulk of a fit-out.
scope: Plaster, gypsum boards and GRC panels
Cement, ceramic, porcelain and terrazzo tiles
Steel rebar, BRC mesh and binding wire
MEP-adjacent: pipes, fittings, conduits, cable tray
Trade pricing and credit terms for repeat clients

facility-maintenance.title: Facility maintenance
facility-maintenance.tagline: Hard FM, soft FM, run on SLAs.
facility-maintenance.description: Integrated facility management for towers, malls, schools, labour camps and mixed-use assets. Hard FM (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, civil) and soft FM (housekeeping, landscaping, waste, security liaison) under one SLA. PPM and reactive contracts run from a CAFM helpdesk with 24/7 dispatch and monthly reporting. Compliant with Qatar Civil Defence inspection cycles.
scope: HVAC: chillers, AHUs, FCUs, ducting, BMS
Electrical: LV, MV, switchgear, generator and UPS
Plumbing: domestic water, drainage, pumps, water-tanks
Civil: minor repairs, painting, façade upkeep

pest-control.title: Pest control
pest-control.description: MOPH-aligned disinfection and integrated pest management for residential, hospitality, food-service, healthcare and industrial assets. Targeted programmes for cockroaches, rodents, bed bugs, termites, mosquitoes and stored-product pests, plus general food-safe disinfection. Discreet residential schedules, overnight commercial slots and full pre/post-construction termite barriers.
scope: Cockroach and ant baiting + gel programmes
Rodent baiting, exclusion and trap monitoring
Bed bug treatment: heat and chemical protocols
Documented service reports for HACCP / ISO audits

about.title: About Pro Care
about.lead: Pro Care Trading Contracting and Facility Services is a Qatar-licensed operator running five disciplines under one roof — so the handover from build to clean to maintain happens without a sub-contract chain.
about.story: Founded in Doha and registered under Commercial Registry 217949, Pro Care is built around a simple thesis: most Qatar projects lose weeks at the seams between contractors. By holding licenses across construction (410029), post-construction cleaning (433091), building materials retail (475281), facility maintenance (811003) and pest control (812904), we collapse those seams into a single accountable team.
